name: DeskTime
description_en:
DeskTime automatically records computer activity and organizes it into time, project and productivity reports. The desktop app, classifications and privacy settings determine what its reports represent; they are not a direct measurement of every business outcome.

Private Time is an explicit pause mechanism. Its documentation says it stops DeskTime device tracking, but it does not stop browser history, operating-system logs or network monitoring outside DeskTime.
description_zh:
DeskTime 自动记录电脑活动，整理为时间、项目及生产力报告。桌面应用、分类及隐私设置决定报告的含义，并不直接衡量所有业务结果。

Private Time 是明确暂停机制。文档表示它停止 DeskTime 的设备追踪，但不影响 DeskTime 之外的浏览器历史、操作系统日志或网络监控。

core_features.explanation_en: Use the desktop app to classify recorded work activity into reports.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过桌面应用把采集活动分类形成报告。

core_features.explanation_en: Pause DeskTime collection from tray/menu controls, subject to organization settings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按组织设置，通过托盘/菜单暂停 DeskTime 采集。

en: Install the tracking client, configure project and application classifications, and record a representative workday. Before a private task, activate Private Time from the system tray/menu bar and resume afterward. The feature is enabled by default but administrators can disable it at company, team or individual level. Verify the actual employee configuration before promising a privacy control.
zh: 安装追踪客户端、配置项目和应用分类，再记录代表性工作日。私人事务前从托盘/菜单栏启动 Private Time，结束后恢复。该功能默认启用，但管理员可按公司、团队或个人关闭。承诺隐私控制前应检查员工实际配置。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: project work interrupted by a private task
sections.title_zh: 示例：项目工作间的私人事务
sections.en:
Install the tracking client, configure project and application classifications, and record a representative workday. Before a private task, activate Private Time from the system tray/menu bar and resume afterward. The feature is enabled by default but administrators can disable it at company, team or individual level. Verify the actual employee configuration before promising a privacy control.

Compare the recorded period, project total and private interval. Missing activity can be a deliberate pause or an offline task, not evidence of absence. No device session was tested.
sections.zh:
安装追踪客户端、配置项目和应用分类，再记录代表性工作日。私人事务前从托盘/菜单栏启动 Private Time，结束后恢复。该功能默认启用，但管理员可按公司、团队或个人关闭。承诺隐私控制前应检查员工实际配置。

核对采集时段、项目总额及私人间隔。缺少活动可能是主动暂停或线下任务，不证明缺勤。本次未测试设备会话。

sections.title_en: Time capture and screenshots have separate tiers
sections.title_zh: 时间采集与截图档位不同
sections.en:
The annual USD view displays Pro $6.42 per user monthly equivalent and Premium $9.17, excluding VAT. Premium adds screenshots, integrations/API and shift scheduling; Enterprise is custom for larger organizations. Confirm monthly prices, active-seat rules and taxes at checkout instead of treating an annual equivalent as month-to-month cost.

The advertised trial is fourteen days. Recording a screenshot does not establish proof of productive output or a lawful payroll decision; retention and access still need configuration and contract checks.
sections.zh:
USD 年付视图显示 Pro 每用户月均 $6.42，Premium $9.17，未含增值税。Premium 加截图、集成/API 及排班，Enterprise 为较大组织定制。结算时应确认月付价格、活跃席位及税费，不能把年付月均当作按月费用。

宣传试用十四天。采集截图不等于证明有效产出或合法薪资决策，保留及访问仍需配置与合同核对。

sections.title_en: A collection policy comes before dashboards
sections.title_zh: 先定采集政策，再看仪表板
sections.en:
Teams evaluating device-based time analysis should document what is captured, who sees it and how mistaken classifications are corrected. Test a private pause and a non-computer work period before financial use. Investigate app state and permissions before treating a gap as missing labor.

The read service is managed with desktop collection; no self-hosted licence, data deletion/export completeness, private-mode enforcement, screenshot security or restoration was verified. Vendor productivity and burnout claims were not adopted as tested outcomes.
sections.zh:
评估设备时间分析的团队应写明采集内容、查看者及分类错误更正方式。财务使用前测试私人暂停及非电脑工作。把间隔视为未劳动前，应调查应用状态与权限。

已读服务为托管加桌面采集，未核实自托管许可、删除/导出完整性、私人模式执行、截图安全或恢复。未将厂商生产力与倦怠主张当作实测结果。
